hero.name: Kotaro Otake
hero.tagline: Empowering Society through AI × Care × DX
hero.subtitle: Engineer building tech-driven solutions for the care industry

about.title: About
about.description: I'm a 24-year-old engineer leading the web team of a large-scale core system renewal project at a major care company, managing a team of 10,000+ users' system scope. Simultaneously running my own business "Takenoko" — creating custom-built applications for care facilities. I combine project management with AI-powered automation to transform how the care industry operates.

philosophy.title: Philosophy
philosophy.quote1: People who choose to continue working in care are rare, incredibly valuable, and noble.
philosophy.quote2: Such talent should never be wasted on mundane paperwork or repetitive analog tasks that anyone could do.
philosophy.quote3: Even as the AI era arrives, care — the ultimate person-to-person work — remains invaluable. It will be the last profession to disappear.
philosophy.belief: Care workers support the very foundation of society. They protect the loved ones of those who keep the world turning — they are critical social infrastructure supporting the heart of our communities.
philosophy.mission: Technology must further empower this noble work.

chant.title: Chant — Core System Renewal
chant.description: Leading the web team for a core system renewal project serving 10,000+ users at a major care company. Managing freelance developers, development schedules, specifications, and quality assurance.

rehab.title: Rehab Management App
rehab.description: Business management app for rehabilitation day services. Built with GAS and Spreadsheets to streamline rehab records and user management. Currently in active production use.

rehabAssign.title: Rehab Auto-Assignment System
rehabAssign.description: Automated system that assigns daily rehabilitation items to users based on complex conditions and constraints. Also features automatic care plan transcription and text generation.

reqBot.title: Auto Requirements Bot
reqBot.description: System that automatically generates requirements documents through video conversations, then auto-generates and deploys mock applications. Powered by Gemini API with diagram generation and text chat support.

puzzleGen.title: Spot-the-Difference Generator
puzzleGen.description: App that generates spot-the-difference puzzle images as PDFs from photos using Gemini API. Well received as recreational activity content at care facilities.

bizApps.title: Business Efficiency Suite
bizApps.description: A collection of business tools including task management, automated book generation, N1 analysis, and ad creative generation/analysis applications.

instaDM.title: Instagram Auto-DM
instaDM.description: Script that auto-generates user lists by keyword and sends bulk custom messages. Achieved 2 appointments from 2,000 messages sent.

lp.title: Takenoko Landing Page
lp.description: Landing page for 'Takenoko' — a custom app development service tailored for care facilities. Communicates the business concept and service offerings.
